g.title: Day26
g.text: DAY 26 | AWS RDS POSTGRESQL — END-TO-END CHEAT SHEET
Private networking • EC2 • SQL • Snapshot • Recovery • Troubleshooting

g.title: ec2
g.text: Public subnet + SSH from My IP

g.title: recover
g.text: Copy verified Ravi row to ORIGINAL DB

g.title: troubles
g.text: • Inline policy size limit → customer-managed policy
• PEM not found → correct local key path
• Only 2 rows after restore → connected to OLD endpoint
• Password rejected → check restored DB credentials + TLS

g.title: concepts
g.text: • Snapshot restore is NOT in-place and NOT a read replica
• Partial loss: validate + selectively merge rows
• Full outage: restore, test, controlled app cutover
• Multi-AZ failover ≠ recovery from accidental DELETE
• Backup retention, RPO/RTO, cost cleanup matter
